motivation: 45 R29 route-audited runs; all four duplicated single-force cases report a later native yaw-only rise. Prevent a duplicate at the optional decision, never suppress native yaw. The force Jacobian maps planar force into possible base-axis torque.
input: Measured signed differences of two existing 40-tick planar force windows, existing paired onset/pose certificate, observed grip and the translational Jacobian column at the already integrated pose. No future force, true plant state, score labels or new clock-based thresholds.
selection: Require strict transverse>yaw-visible component in both instruments, with agreeing transverse sign, to announce early. Unknown/visible/mixed falls back for the excursion. No fitted cutoff, new timing, retuning or mass/case rules.
source_tests: Rotation/sign invariance; unknown/disagree/tie remain on native; no additional plant solve.
historical: Single immutable candidate, C3 and R29 composed physical signatures on disclosed R26 156 and 24 signed events plus 33 non-training normals. Preserve each old strict onset within +5ms and +5 active samples, no new duplicate/prealarm/false/tail or tool losses. Check actual opposite/distinct force vs joined long in known cohorts. Report every absolute miss; motion is unchanged.
fresh: Separate pre-enrolled plan only if full historical gates relative to C3 AND basic composed, signed/33-normal and previously disclosed true close controls pass. No further candidate may take its place. R27 114 and R28 19 are not available to this study. Never silently change R10.
limits: Choosing an optional route, not a proof of causal separation of all disturbances; yaw only observes the tangential component. Compare against actual submitted R10 as well as research C3 before drawing any deployment inference.
